headline: Mau Gold Digger
title: Mau | Free Gold Coins From The Ranch | Palworld Guide
video_script: Gold coins for free? Put Mau on your Ranch. Its partner skill, Gold Digger, sometimes digs up Gold Coins while it is assigned there. Mau is a Dark Pal with Farming and Gathering at level one, so it is a cheap, steady way to earn extra money on the side. Do you run a Mau ranch for gold? Comment below!
description: Mau in Palworld 1.0: Gold Digger sometimes digs up Gold Coins at your Ranch, with Farming and Gathering at level one.
